units.source_text: 当时，这位日本旅行家的口气里充满嘲讽。

en.t: At the time, the Japanese traveler’s tone was full of mockery.

units.source_text: 但是，金花将头靠在他的胳膊上，

en.t: But Jinhua rested her head against his arm,

units.source_text: 鸦翅般乌黑的秀发服帖的垂在身侧，一如往常般开心的笑着，露出小虎牙。

en.t: her beautiful hair, black as a crow’s wing, hanging smoothly at her side, as she smiled happily as usual and showed her small canine teeth.
